editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: FP Markets is a legitimate ASIC/CySEC-regulated broker scoring 7.8/10 from NAFT in 2026. Raw account at 0.0 pips + $6 round-turn ties Tickmill and Vantage as the cheapest regulated ECN commission — and undercuts IC Markets and Pepperstone by $1 per lot. The 10,000+ instrument count, full platform suite (MT4/MT5/cTrader/TradingView), and 4.9/5 Trustpilot rating from 9,000+ reviews make this arguably the most underrated broker in the market. Twenty years of ASIC-regulated operation provides genuine safety. The limitations are relative: no options or futures, IRESS DMA costs extra, and the retail loss rate sits in the 74-89% range. But for the ECN trader who wants the cheapest regulated commission with maximum platform flexibility and proven client satisfaction — FP Markets delivers better value than its more famous competitors.
